title: Historical Tristan Git root
summary: Existing historical and active research repository used as a federated provenance source; not copied wholesale into this kernel.
frontiers: Bind exact source snapshots per task instead of treating repository head as timeless truth.

title: Tristan Memory Registry v0.4
summary: Minimum-sufficient routing index for current Tristan work; explicitly non-exhaustive.
failures: Registry is not exhaustive corpus closure.
frontiers: Reconcile newer readback-verified deltas before changing canonical authority.

title: TRISTAN Ω-CONTEXT BOOTSTRAP
summary: Human-readable bootstrap defining retrieval, analysis, modification, addition, deletion/supersession, and memory migration protocols.
failures: Drive pointer is not proof that current contents were loaded.
frontiers: Bind revision-level provenance when a task materially depends on a particular bootstrap revision.

title: Ω ONE SKILL TRISTAN R1
summary: Single entrypoint/compiler for bounded extreme improvement, generalization, generation, automation, regeneration, Anti-Ego selection, and maximum authorized execution.
frontiers: Keep as thin compiler; do not clone downstream owners.

title: Ω MASTER EXECUTION — TRISTAN R1
summary: Bounded mission-closure orchestrator over observable, authorized, reversible and verifiable capabilities.
frontiers: Preserve execution/verification separation and exact-head qualification.

title: Reality Anchor boundary
summary: External observations and independent evidence outrank self-consistent internal scoring when claims concern reality.
frontiers: Materialize domain-specific RealityAnchor contracts only when required by a task.

title: Tristan Public K* Kernel R0.1
summary: Small public regenerable kernel with typed TristanObject records, federated registry, bounded Context* compilation, deterministic intent receipts, CLI, tests, and explicit epistemic/authority boundaries.
failures: Initial editable-install CI court failed because setuptools.build_meta was unavailable under --no-build-isolation; fixed by removing unnecessary packaging dependency from the qualification court.
frontiers: Benchmark current token-overlap Context* baseline before adding embeddings/graph retrieval.
Add source adapters only for concrete residuals.

title: Context Retrieval Anti-Ego Court R0.2
summary: Merged bounded shadow retrieval court comparing the current R0.1 scorer with BM25 core/full, normalized TF-IDF full-field, SQLite FTS5 full-field and NO_ACTION without authorizing a runtime mutation.
failures: The frozen fixture has only seven objects and self-authored labels; it cannot justify runtime promotion or semantic-superiority claims.
BM25_CORE did not beat the current R0.1 scorer on holdout.
frontiers: Freeze a materially larger independently labeled authorized corpus/query court before runtime retrieval changes.
Compare semantic/embedding and graph/hybrid challengers only under matched budgets and the same frozen labels.
